title: Isar Aerospace reaches orbit and deploys payloads on second flight
why_read: A concrete milestone in the growing European private launch industry, of interest to those following aerospace engineering progress.
analysis: Isar Aerospace is a German orbital launch startup, and reaching orbit on only its second flight is a notable technical achievement in a field where early failures are common. The story is more about industry/space-race progress than deep engineering detail, but it's a legitimate hard-tech milestone. Engineers interested in aerospace, propulsion, or the new-space ecosystem would find it relevant, though it lacks technical depth for a pure engineering readership.
